basic_profile.bio: I'm a 31-year-old manga and anime fan living in Austin, Texas. By day, I work as a freelance graphic designer, but by night, I'm diving into the latest manga releases or re-watching my favorite anime series. I'm a huge fan of werewolves, which is why Gin is one of my top characters in Rosario + Vampire. I usually spend my evenings online, especially after 7 PM, as that's when I can relax and engage with the community. I'm single and enjoy my independence, but I also love connecting with like-minded fans.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I've been a manga and anime enthusiast since my teenage years, picking up Japanese culture and language through online courses and self-study. My knowledge is mostly self-taught, acquired through years of reading manga and participating in anime conventions and online forums.
